name: Residents below the poverty line
source: U.S. Census Bureau 2024 Small Area Income and Poverty Estimates (SAIPE), Monterey County; distributed through FRED
notes: FRED series page now captured and readable: it identifies the source as Census Bureau SAIPE, annual estimates, and reports Monterey County 2024 = 13.7%. The official 2024 SAIPE release confirms the estimate year: https://www.census.gov/data/datasets/2024/demo/saipe/2024-state-and-county.html. QuickFacts also displays 13.7%, but its row omits the data year. County/local tier-1 searches did not retrieve a later countywide poverty estimate; the captured FRED series page is the Tier 2 Census value.

name: Unemployment rate
source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Local Area Unemployment Statistics, retrieved through FRED: Unemployment Rate in Monterey County, CA (annual, not seasonally adjusted)
notes: The captured series page reports 7.9% for calendar year 2025, updated May 19, 2026. It identifies BLS as source, annual frequency, and the civilian labor force denominator; the labor force includes civilian noninstitutionalized persons ages 16+ who are employed or unemployed, and the unemployment rate is unemployed persons as a percent of that labor force. The County 2025–26 Legislative Platform (opened at https://www.countyofmonterey.gov/home/showpublisheddocument/138247/638736919326900000) cites 5.2% in a November 2024 EDD report; that cited figure is not presented here as a final full-calendar-year 2024 comparison. Earlier indexed 2024 candidates of 7.3–7.4% were not used.
